Game Overview

At its heart, Billiards on Ice is a sports game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Billiards on Ice comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Billiards on Ice?

Billiards on Ice is a free sports game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Billiards on Ice free to play?

Yes, Billiards on Ice is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
